limit-three-views.alt: Three panels for f(x) = (x² − x − 2)/(x − 2). The graph is the line y = x + 1 with an open circle at (2, 3) because f(2) is undefined. The table gives f(1.9) = 2.9, f(1.99) = 2.99, f(1.999) = 2.999 and f(2.001) = 3.001, f(2.01) = 3.01, f(2.1) = 3.1. The formula factors as (x − 2)(x + 1)/(x − 2) = x + 1 for x not 2. All three give a limit of 3 as x approaches 2.
